803-2493-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-2493-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Archaeomancer token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-3967-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

751-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
751-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Shrieking Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-8176.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

1339-1940-3967.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

645-804-1267-3899.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-804-1267-3899.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1308-4094-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

1636-5627-7892.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-5627-7892.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2073-2099-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

348-1152-3191-5075-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-3191-5075-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Kairi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Kairi and any creature not part of the combo.
When Kairi dies, it and Ogre Slumlord triggers.
Resolve the Kairi trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2583-4636-4772.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

3990-4644-7791.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any type.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Incubation Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

5477-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5477-7060-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5477-7060-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

891-2843-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

141-5147-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-5147-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-5147-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1786-6822-6980.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1786-6822-6980.description:
Draw a card.
Queza and Lyla trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Resolve the first Lyla trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
1786-6822-6980.notes: With the additional Lyla trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

454-1978-3717.description:
Cause Viridian Joiner to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2981-3661-5220.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1274-3197-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-6823.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2933-3499-5798.easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator paired with Drowner of Hope.
1409-2933-3499-5798.description:
Activate Drowner of Hope by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Drowner of Hope trigger, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Drowner of Hope.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

632-2034-3621-4068-5129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
632-2034-3621-4068-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4068-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

4659-5394-6291.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2225-2585-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2225-2585-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Grim Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

617-2364-4235-4547.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Forsaken Monument triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Mana Vault.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Mana Vault.
Repeat.

64-372-961.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-961.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

141-167-5231.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
When Naru Meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

2084-3122.notablePrerequisites: Undercover Operative is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-3122.description: Activate Undercover Operative by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Undercover Operative into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

1350-4094-5287.notablePrerequisites:
Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1350-4094-5287.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat from step 2.

1303-2232-2766-3304.notablePrerequisites:
A Swamp and a Forest on the battlefield.
An additional Swamp, Forest, and seven creature cards in graveyard.
1303-2232-2766-3304.description:
Activate a Swamp and a Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{G}.
Cast Molderhulk by paying {B}{G}.
Molderhulk, Necroduality, and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a Molderhulk token.
Molderhulk and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Molderhulk to your hand.
Resolve the token Molderhulk trigger, returning a Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a different Forest from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the nontoken Molderhulk's trigger, returning a Swamp from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning a different Swamp from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing the token Molderhulk, drawing six cards and discarding a Swamp, a Forest, and any third card.
Repeat.

1737-2034-4636-5146.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Thopter Assembly triggers.
Holding priority, activate Prototype Portal by paying {6} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Gonti's Aether Heart.
Gonti's Aether Heart enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Thopter Assembly trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and creating five 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens.
The Thopters enter the battlefield, triggering Gonti's Aether Heart five times, causing you to get ten {E}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar five times by sacrificing the five Thopters, adding ten {C}.
Cast Thopter Assembly by paying {6}.
Thopter Assembly enter the battlefield, triggering Gonti's Aether Heart, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Gonti's Aether Heart by paying eight {E} and exiling it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

880-1659-2757.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3765-5141.description:
Activate all your mana-producing permanents, adding at least {8}{W}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Teferi's Protection by paying {2}{W}, phasing out all of your permanents and preventing your life total from changing until your next turn.
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents that are not phased out, exiling all cards in hands and graveyards, and setting each opponent's life total to 1.

2034-5003-5246.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enkira, adding {C}{C}.
Enkira dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Enkira from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Enkira enters the battlefield, creating two 2/2 Walker creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Walker, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
